info.name: Analyst Reports Raw Text Analyst Insights Dividends API

params.name: page
params.description: Page offset. For optimization, performance and technical reasons, page offsets are limited from 0 - 100000. Limit the query results by other parameters such as date

params.name: pagesize
params.description: Number of results returned. Limit 1000

params.name: parameters[date]
params.description: Date to query for calendar data. Shorthand for date_from and date_to if they are the same. Defaults for latest

params.name: parameters[date_from]
params.description: Date to query from point in time

params.name: parameters[date_to]
params.description: Date to query to point in time

params.name: parameters[date_sort]
params.description: Dividend date field to sort on (newest to oldest)

params.name: parameters[dividend_yield_operation]
params.description: Specifies how to filter using dividend yield. gt = Greater Than, gte = Greater Than Equal, eq = Equal, lt = Less Than, lte = Less Than Equal

params.name: parameters[dividend_yield]
params.description: The dividend yield amount to filter by. Defaults to using Equal To the amount indicated. 1 = 100%

params.name: parameters[importance]
params.description: The importance level to filter by. Uses Greater Than or Equal To the importance indicated

params.name: parameters[tickers]
params.description: One or more ticker symbols separated by a comma. Maximum 50 tickers

params.name: parameters[updated]
params.description: Records last Updated Unix timestamp (UTC). This will force the sort order to be Greater Than or Equal to the timestamp indicated

items.docs: Returns dividends data for a selected period and/or security. Includes dividend amounts, ex-dividend dates, payment dates, dividend yields, and other relevant dividend information for stocks.

items.docs: Returns dividends data for a selected period and/or security, including both confirmed and unconfirmed dividend dates. V2.2 includes additional fields: confirmed, period, and year. This version provides more detailed information about dividend confirmation status and periodicity.
